rules.message: Domain or persistence model files changed but the development seeder did not: confirm the seeded entity graph is unaffected or update DbSeeder (persistence.workflow, step 3).
Migration files changed: review the generated migration before completion (persistence.workflow, step 5).
Persistence mappings changed without a migration: confirm no schema change is needed or create one (persistence.workflow, step 4).
